status: PROPOSAL ONLY — not applied; no file under data/ changed
offset_convention: Half-open Unicode code-point ranges [start,end) within the destination row field, zero-based. Codepoints counted with Array.from, so astral characters count as one.
verification: Every one of the 23 historical pieces was reconstructed byte-exactly from current row slices. 20 as contiguous slices of a single current row; 1 as a prefix of a row that grew; 1 whose own row is unchanged but a neighbour changed; 1 deleted as a duplicated period (no destination claimed).
why_not_aliases: All 23 ids are still live rows. src/row-splits.ts:170-172 rejects an alias whose id is in `current` ("duplicate or reused alias identity"). And src/schema.ts:237-245 forbids aliases on V1 records. So neither an ordinary alias nor a drop-in V2/V3 alias can express these; they need a versioned destination mapping keyed to the historical id, which is what this file is.
